notes: Retrieval eval for a large Harry Potter omnibus PDF. A question is a 'hit' at k if any of the top-k retrieved chunks contains all expected_keywords (case-insensitive substring). Pages are unknown across editions, so we score on keywords rather than expected_page. Unanswerable items are excluded from hit metrics and used to sanity-check refusals.
